learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to find where things are hiding, like inside, outside, on top, or at the bottom!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The cute furry cat is sleeping inside her cozy basket. When she wakes up, she will jump outside to play in the sunny garden!
Look at the big tall tree! A little bird is singing at the very top. Our furry cat is resting at the bottom of the tree.
The red ball is near the cat, so she can touch it. But the blue butterfly flew far away into the sky!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Hide and Seek with Toys
fun_activity.instructions: Hide your favorite toy inside a small box or place it on top of a table. Ask your family to find it using words like 'top' and 'inside'!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can clearly tell if our furry friend is inside the house or outside.
⭐ We know how to look for things at the top of a shelf and at the bottom.
